entities.summary: Yuan, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Yuan (Mongol) Dynasty (1271–1294). Preceded by Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan dynasty with its capital at Dadu (Beijing). Their legacy influenced Two failed Mongol invasions of Japan destroyed by typhoons ('kamikaze') and Red Turban Rebellion.
